name: openai-images
description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI's GPT Image models from Claude Code, with the cost of every image shown

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: API key from a dedicated OpenAI project with a budget limit. Kept in the OS secure store and passed only to this plugin's MCP server.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Image model used when a call names none. Any OpenAI image model id.

default_quality.title: Default quality
default_quality.description: Quality used when a call names none. Higher quality costs more per image.

max_cost_per_call.title: Max cost per call (USD)
max_cost_per_call.description: A call whose estimated cost is above this is refused unless Claude asks you and retries with allow_expensive.
